summary:
Yelp is the local-review site at yelp.com. The red burst in the tab is the favicon business bookmarks use, saved from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against yelp.com. HTML came from https://www.yelp.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://yelp.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://yelp.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #ff1122 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 21144 bytes) from https://yelp.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
